title: How this viewer saves a question
description: A second map, grounded in this app’s source. Nodes can represent experiences, data or decisions without a language-specific parser.

provenance.method: Authored from the implementation delivered with this viewer.
provenance.limitations: A single save path; startup, browser layout and all error branches are outside this map.

nodes.title: Ask a question
nodes.summary: A question can target a node or the whole map.
nodes.body: The inspector collects a plain-text question. Save question sends an addNote operation with the currently viewed revision. Historical revisions cannot accept new notes.

nodes.title: Local API
nodes.summary: Check origin, token, JSON size and expected revision.
nodes.body: The Node server binds 127.0.0.1. It refuses foreign Host/Origin and cross-site requests. Writes require the session token and JSON. It passes a validated patch into Store.

nodes.title: Immutable revision
nodes.summary: Validate, flush and publish one complete snapshot.
nodes.body: Store.patch applies the note to a clone. Store.commit validates the document, checks expectedRevision and publishes a flushed JSON file through an atomic hard link. A collision fails instead of overwriting a prior version.

nodes.title: Agent reads the same question
nodes.summary: CLI reads durable notes in the new revision.
nodes.body: The owner sees the new saved revision. An agent can run node cli.mjs get viewer-guide and read the same note in document.notes, then submit another revision with an explanation. No automatic agent wakeup occurs.

edges.label: submits addNote
edges.body: The question is sent with author and base revision.

edges.label: validates and commits
edges.body: A successful write publishes a new complete revision.

edges.label: is read by
edges.body: The CLI and browser read the same durable snapshots.

views.title: A question becomes shared context
views.description: Understand the small bridge between the owner and the coding agent.
